items.title_zh: AxonOS 开放脑机接口社区雷达
items.title_en: AxonOS Community Radar for Open BCI
bullets_zh: AxonOS 社区维护一个自动更新的开放脑机接口领域雷达地图。
它汇总开放脑机接口生态中的社区项目与工具。
帮助开发者跟踪社区活动、空白点和新兴开源 BCI 资源。
bullets_en: AxonOS community maintains an auto-updated radar map of the open brain-computer-interface field.
It aggregates community projects and tools across the open BCI ecosystem.
Helps developers track community activity, gaps, and emerging open-source BCI resources.
items.brief: AxonOS 社区雷达自动更新开放脑机接口项目地图。
items.brief_en: Auto-updated AxonOS radar mapping the open brain-computer-interface ecosystem.
items.raw_excerpt: AxonOS Radar — a living, auto-updated map of the open brain-computer-interface field. An AxonOS community project.

items.title_zh: NIA 项目：自适应非侵入式脑机接口数字环境
items.title_en: NIA Project for Adaptive Non-Invasive BCI Digital Environment
bullets_zh: NIA-Project GitHub 仓库实现了面向人机数字交互的集成数字环境。
它针对自适应、非侵入式脑机接口，而非植入式设备。
可作为构建交互式脑机接口系统的软件栈示例。
bullets_en: The NIA-Project GitHub repository implements an integrated digital environment for human-digital interaction.
It targets adaptive and non-invasive brain-computer interfaces rather than implants.
Useful as a software-stack example for building interactive BCI systems.
items.brief: NIA 项目实现自适应非侵入式脑机接口人机交互数字环境。
items.brief_en: GitHub project implementing an integrated digital environment for adaptive non-invasive BCI interaction.
items.raw_excerpt: Realization of an Integrated Digital Environment for Human-Digital Interaction in Adaptive and Non-invasive Brain-Computer Interfaces

items.title_zh: EEG Deformer：用于脑机接口的 PyTorch 变换器实现
items.title_en: EEG Deformer PyTorch Transformer for BCI
bullets_zh: 提供用于脑电解码的密集卷积变换器 PyTorch 实现。
面向使用非侵入式脑电信号的脑机接口应用。
可作为深度学习脑电解码实验的参考代码库。
bullets_en: Provides a PyTorch implementation of a dense convolutional transformer for EEG decoding.
Targets brain-computer interface applications using non-invasive EEG signals.
Useful as a reference codebase for deep-learning EEG classification experiments.
items.brief: EEG Deformer 提供脑机接口 EEG 解码的 PyTorch 变换器实现。
items.brief_en: PyTorch dense convolutional transformer implementation for decoding non-invasive EEG in BCI applications.
items.raw_excerpt: Decode EEG signals using this PyTorch implementation of a dense convolutional transformer for brain-computer interface applications.

items.title_zh: 基于 EEG 的脑机接口 Unity 游戏控制项目
bullets_zh: 实现基于脑电的脑机接口，用于 Unity 实时控制。
使用信号处理、CSP/LDA 分类和 LSL 通信。
展示面向交互应用的实用消费级/科研 EEG 流程。
bullets_en: Implements an EEG-based brain-computer interface for real-time control in Unity.
Uses signal processing, CSP/LDA classification, and LSL communication.
Demonstrates a practical consumer/research EEG pipeline for interactive applications.
items.brief: 基于 EEG 的脑机接口项目，用 CSP/LDA 与 LSL 控制 Unity 游戏。
items.brief_en: EEG-based BCI project using CSP/LDA and LSL to control Unity games in real time.
items.raw_excerpt: EEG-based brain-computer interface for real-time Unity game control using signal processing, CSP/LDA classification and LSL communication.

items.title_zh: BrainCo 公开 API 接口档案
bullets_zh: API Evangelist 维护了 BrainCo 公开 API 接口的第三方档案。
该档案覆盖由哈佛创新实验室孵化、开发非侵入式脑机接口硬件与开发者 SDK 的 BrainCo。
它有助于独立了解消费级和科研 BCI 设备周围的开发者生态。
bullets_en: API Evangelist maintains a third-party profile of BrainCo's public API surface.
The profile covers BrainCo, a Harvard-innovation-lab-founded company building non-invasive BCI hardware and developer SDKs.
It matters as an independent map of the developer-facing ecosystem around consumer and research BCI devices.
items.brief: BrainCo 公开 API 第三方档案，梳理非侵入式 BCI 开发者生态。
items.brief_en: Third-party BrainCo public API profile mapping the non-invasive BCI developer ecosystem.
items.raw_excerpt: BrainCo — independent third-party profile of a public API surface, by API Evangelist. BrainCo is a Harvard-innovation-lab-founded neurotechnology company building non-invasive brain-computer interface (BCI) hardware and the developer SDKs that surround it. Its consumer and research line centers on wearable EEG headbands - Focus, Focus1 and FocusCal

items.title_zh: MindAid 辅助型 SSVEP 脑机接口（GitHub）
bullets_zh: GitHub项目MindAid实现基于SSVEP的辅助型脑机接口，使用EEG信号。
它面向基本需求的实时选择，具有无障碍应用价值。
该项目于2026年9月发布在GitHub，属于非侵入式EEG接口而非植入系统。
bullets_en: GitHub project named MindAid implements an assistive SSVEP-based BCI using EEG signals.
It targets real-time selection of basic needs, suggesting practical accessibility use cases.
Published on GitHub in September 2026 as a non-invasive EEG interface rather than an implant system.
items.brief: GitHub上的SSVEP辅助型非侵入式BCI项目，可实时选择基本需求。
items.brief_en: GitHub project for an assistive SSVEP non-invasive BCI that uses EEG to select basic needs in real time.
items.raw_excerpt: MindAid Assistive SSVEP BCI. Assistive SSVEP-based Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) for real-time selection of basic needs through EEG signals.

bullets_zh: GitHub项目EmotivNeuroGame是Unity 6赛车游戏，通过Emotiv EPOC X的EEG信号控制。
该项目作为LAB应用科学大学BEng论文完成，展示消费级非侵入式BCI应用。
仓库展示了将现成EEG头带与交互软件集成的实践方式。
bullets_en: GitHub project EmotivNeuroGame is a Unity 6 racing game controlled by Emotiv EPOC X EEG signals.
It was created as a BEng thesis at LAB University of Applied Sciences, showing consumer non-invasive BCI use.
The repo demonstrates practical integration of an off-the-shelf EEG headset with interactive software.
items.brief: 基于Emotiv EPOC X的Unity EEG赛车游戏项目，展示消费级非侵入式BCI控制。
items.brief_en: GitHub Unity racing game controlled by Emotiv EPOC X EEG, demonstrating consumer non-invasive BCI control.
items.raw_excerpt: Brain-Computer Interface racing game in Unity 6, controlled via Emotiv EPOC X EEG signals. BEng thesis, LAB University of Applied Sciences.

items.title_zh: neoxai：BCI/EEG开放数据集与资源精选
items.title_en: neoxai: Curated BCI/EEG Open Datasets and Resources
bullets_zh: GitHub项目neowalter/neoxai精选开放BCI/EEG数据集、模型、处理方法及归档新闻/论文。
该项目于2026-09-19在GitHub列出，作为非侵入式EEG资源中心。
它降低了研究人员构建或评估非侵入式BCI系统的发现成本。
bullets_en: GitHub project neowalter/neoxai curates open BCI/EEG datasets, models, processing methods, and archived news/papers.
It was listed on GitHub on 2026-09-19 as a non-invasive EEG resource hub.
It matters because it lowers discovery cost for researchers building or evaluating non-invasive BCI systems.
items.brief: 非侵入式BCI/EEG开放数据集与资源精选，便于研究入门。
items.brief_en: Curated non-invasive BCI/EEG datasets and resources for research onboarding.
items.raw_excerpt: Curated BCI/EEG open datasets, models, processing methods, and archived news/papers

items.title_en: ADS1299 Core SDK for EEG/BCI Ecosystem
bullets_zh: GitHub项目yuguoyu123456/ADS1299-Core-SDK提供开放ADS1299 EEG/BCI生态，含硬件、MCU/FPGA包与分析流程。
该项目于2026-09-19在GitHub列出，面向非侵入式EEG采集开发。
它标准化低成本EEG硬件集成，利于BCI研究与教育。
bullets_en: GitHub project yuguoyu123456/ADS1299-Core-SDK provides an open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem with hardware, MCU/FPGA packages, and analysis workflows.
It was listed on GitHub on 2026-09-19 for non-invasive EEG acquisition development.
It matters because it standardizes low-cost EEG hardware integration for BCI research and education.
items.brief: ADS1299 EEG/BCI开源生态SDK，覆盖硬件与信号处理。
items.brief_en: Open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem SDK covering hardware, integration, and signal analysis.
items.raw_excerpt: Building the world’s largest and most comprehensive open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem — 8–64CH hardware, 200 MCU/SoC/DSP & FPGA target/reference packages, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, Python/MATLAB/R EEG analysis, BCI workflows, validation, education and research.

items.title_en: NeuroRVQ-RS: Rust Inference for EEG/ECG/EMG Tokenization
bullets_zh: GitHub项目Fazalr714/neurorvq-rs实现纯Rust的NeuroRVQ推理，用于EEG、ECG和EMG信号tokenize。
该项目于2026-09-18在GitHub列出，使用Burn 0.20且无Python依赖。
它为BCI流程中的非侵入式生物信号建模提供轻量Rust路径。
bullets_en: GitHub project Fazalr714/neurorvq-rs implements pure-Rust NeuroRVQ inference to tokenize EEG, ECG, and EMG signals.
It was listed on GitHub on 2026-09-18 using Burn 0.20 with zero Python dependencies.
It matters because it offers a lightweight Rust path for non-invasive biosignal modeling in BCI pipelines.
items.brief: Rust实现的EEG/ECG/EMG神经RVQ推理，便于非侵入信号建模。
items.brief_en: Pure-Rust NeuroRVQ inference tokenizes EEG, ECG, and EMG signals for non-invasive BCI modeling.
items.raw_excerpt: Build pure-Rust NeuroRVQ inference to tokenize EEG, ECG, and EMG signals with Burn 0.20 and zero Python dependencies

bullets_zh: GitHub仓库Andreusolad/bci-motor-imagery-sola-ca-ada聚焦运动想象BCI。
名称显示可能使用SOLA、CA和ADA方法进行非侵入式EEG解码。
发布于2026-09-18；可作为EEG运动想象BCI的开放代码资源。
bullets_en: GitHub repository Andreusolad/bci-motor-imagery-sola-ca-ada focuses on motor-imagery BCI work.
The name suggests SOLA, CA, and ADA methods for non-invasive EEG decoding.
Published 2026-09-18; useful as an open code/resource for EEG motor-imagery BCI.
items.brief: GitHub上的EEG运动想象BCI解码项目，适合非侵入式脑机接口算法参考。
items.brief_en: GitHub project for EEG motor-imagery BCI decoding, useful for non-invasive BCI algorithm reference.

bullets_zh: GitHub仓库ianmarroquin/mi-decoding-literature整理运动想象解码文献。
摘要提及EEG BCI、智能眼镜及主要期刊会议中的MI解码研究。
发布于2026-09-18；有助于跟踪非侵入式BCI研究趋势。
bullets_en: GitHub repository ianmarroquin/mi-decoding-literature curates motor-imagery decoding literature.
Its summary mentions EEG BCIs, smart glasses, and MI decoding in major journals/conferences.
Published 2026-09-18; useful for tracking non-invasive BCI research trends.
items.brief: GitHub上的EEG运动想象解码文献清单，帮助跟踪非侵入式BCI研究。
items.brief_en: GitHub literature list on EEG motor-imagery decoding, helping track non-invasive BCI research.
items.raw_excerpt: EEG BCIs, Smart Glasses, and Motor Imagery decoding research published in major journals and conferences.
